findings.title: Covering becomes directional through the covenant sequence
findings.claim: The focus verb kufr retains its ordinary denial reading while the pericope lets its covering image become directional: harmful human covering of a contested truth stands beside, and is distinguished from, divine covering-away of wrongs.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 5:17:2:1 meets the covenant and disclosure sequence at 5:12, 5:13, and 5:15. Divine covering of wrongs and later human kufr occur in one conditional covenant frame; words are then moved from their places, a remembered share is neglected, hidden material is addressed, and speech brings it into distinction and light. That contact changes the focus from an undifferentiated cover/deny label into a direction-sensitive reading of agent, object, and effect.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see how one covering field can describe mercy that removes wrongs and a statement that conceals truth, and why the focus attaches the harmful direction to what was said.
findings.containment: Before the supplied context, the focus can be read simply as kufr meaning covering or denial; after it, the pericope also differentiates reparative divine covering from harmful human concealment. The focus still condemns the reported denial. The HFT record supplies complete exact-Arabic anchors but not independent target morphology, and its polarity inference remains attributed; a live alternative keeps the expiation and base-form denial uses lexically separate.

epistemic.reason: Exact Arabic anchors cover every cited ayah and the focus return is present, but the HFT coordinate, role, and contextual polarity claims are legacy-unbound and target morphology is not independently supplied.

findings.mechanism: The focus son carrier at 5:17:9:1 and 5:17:22:1 meets 5:18, where collective son language is paired with beloved status, punishment, created human embodiment, selective forgiveness and punishment, and the same dominion refrain. The repeated claim-question-correction structure retroactively changes the focus from a biographical reference alone into a controlled test of exceptional divine identity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the repeated mother and son naming matters: it places the claim under the same vulnerability test that 5:18 makes explicit, while preserving the focus's particular reference to Mary.
findings.containment: Before the parallel, the focus can be read as stressing Mary's motherhood to deny that one individual is God; after it, the paired ayat also regulate son-language as a category whose bearers remain created and vulnerable. The live alternative is that 5:17 addresses a unique identity proposition while 5:18 addresses only collective privilege, so the son claims remain partly distinct. Exact Arabic anchors are complete, but HFT roles and segmentation are legacy-unbound.

epistemic.reason: The adjacent ayah is exact and the structural parallel is specific, but the HFT attribution and target morphology are not independently supplied, so the retrospective category reading remains qualified.

findings.title: Creaturely agency is bestowed and bounded
findings.claim: The focus asks who can possess even one thing against God; the pericope adds a scale in which human rule and personal possession are real because bestowed and remain bounded, while divine mulk is comprehensive. Before the context, the question can sound like a denial of every creaturely possession; after it, it also denies counter-sovereign ownership.
findings.mechanism: The focus possession and dominion carriers meet 5:20, where a people are made kings and given what they did not have, and 5:25, where Moses restricts his possession to himself and his brother. The contact distinguishes delegated status and narrow relational control from the focus's comprehensive divine ownership, changing the reading from creaturely nullity to bounded agency beneath sovereignty.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish the ability creatures may receive from the kind of ownership that could intercept God, so the focus question becomes a scale of agency rather than a flat denial of all human action.
findings.containment: The focus still denies that anyone can control anything against God and still attributes the whole cosmic dominion to God. The after-reading arranges bestowed kingship and restricted possession beneath that floor; the HFT source is legacy-unbound and the target morphology is not independently supplied. A live alternative is that 5:20's kingship is social status while the focus's yamilku is responsibility, making the relation analogous rather than one graded concept.

epistemic.reason: Exact 5:17, 5:20, and 5:25 Arabic anchors and an explicit exception structure support the relation, while the HFT arrangement of these forms as a graded agency scale remains legacy-unbound.

findings.title: Capacity can reopen disclosure after a lull
findings.claim: The final qadīr remains a comprehensive capacity statement, and its recurrence after the interval in 5:19 also lets that capacity be heard as reopening communication through arrival, clarification, good news, and warning. Before the recurrence, the focus closure can sound limited to destructive force; after it, the same unrestricted ability also underwrites renewed disclosure.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 5:17:42:1 meets 5:19's explicit interval, repeated arrival, explanatory speech, good news, warning, and repeated capacity formula. The contact changes what the final capacity can make perceptible: it can reactivate a communicative relation after absence while the destruction reading remains intact.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the last capacity formula as capable of closing both a destruction counterfactual and a renewed-message sequence, making the interval and the return of the messenger semantically consequential.
findings.containment: This is a contextual resonance, not an exclusive grammatical meaning: 5:19 is not syntactically tied only to messenger-sending, so the prose must say that the formula can underwrite reopening communication. Exact Arabic anchors are complete, but the HFT trace and its word segmentation are legacy-unbound; the destructive force and communication reading remain co-present.

epistemic.reason: The focus formula recurs in exact 5:19 context with an explicit interval-to-arrival-to-disclosure sequence, but the communication extension is an attributed HFT inference and is marked non-exclusive.

findings.title: Sovereignty also governs access within space
findings.claim: The focus merism of heavens, earth, and what lies between still states total dominion; the pericope also lets its earth and interval terms resonate with a topology of assigned land, threshold entry, separation, prohibition, and wandering. This is an exploratory extension of what divine sovereignty makes governable, not a replacement for the plain ownership statement.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers at 5:17:30:1 and 5:17:34:1 meet the later land assignment, gate entry, requested separation, prohibition, and wandering occurrences at 5:21, 5:23, 5:25, and 5:26. Their contact changes the cosmic merism from a static list of domains into a possible account of jurisdiction over relations within space.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the interval between heaven and earth as part of the stated domain and can see why later access, boundary, and exclusion scenes may resonate with that domain without turning mulk literally into gatekeeping.
findings.containment: Before the later land narrative, heavens, earth, and what lies between form an exhaustive merism for total ownership; after it, they can also be heard as a topology in which access is assigned, entered, separated, withheld, and wandered. The result is exploratory, the HFT source is legacy-unbound, and the exact context Arabic verifies surface contact only. No literal claim that mulk means gatekeeping is made, and no wider whole-surah spatial system is imported.

epistemic.reason: The focus earth/interval terms and all five later context ayat have exact Arabic anchors, but arranging them as spatial jurisdiction is explicitly an HFT exploratory inference with no independent target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İlahi bağlamda bütün varlık üzerindeki mutlak ve kalıcı egemenlik anlatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus mulk occurrence carries the supplied divine-sovereignty facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus interval and later land, gate, separation, and prohibition occurrences independently activate the HFT role: Sovereign rule anchors the claim that spatial relations fall under jurisdiction.
branch_activations.activation: Divine sovereignty meets concrete rules of access and exclusion, allowing the focus's ownership formula to be heard as jurisdiction over spatial relations.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The cosmic domain can also be perceived as an administered field of access and boundary.
branch_activations.boundary: This is exploratory spatial administration, not a literal redefinition of mulk as gatekeeping.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam iki veya daha çok taraf arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konumdur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus interval and the 5:25 between-occurrences carry the supplied core facet of an interval or middle between parties.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus mulk occurrence and later separation occurrence independently activate the HFT roles: The interval between domains makes relational space itself part of the owned totality; the repeated interval locates separation relationally between groups.
branch_activations.activation: The interval word meets a later request to separate parties, turning what lies between the cosmic poles into a relational boundary that can be governed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The phrase what lies between them becomes newly perceptible as meaningful relational space, not empty filler between two domains.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the supplied core interval facet is activated; the later separation is a contextual resonance, not a claim that all between-uses share one sense.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied 5:21:6 occurrence is the HFT-attributed establishing-decree carrier; no independent branch gloss is supplied for this context branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sovereignty and interval carriers supply the separate return, and the HFT role is: An establishing decree assigns the land, making access a juridical relation rather than bare physical proximity.
branch_activations.activation: An assigned land meets the focus's owned domain by showing that sovereignty can specify who may enter a portion of it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Earth in the focus can resonate as a domain whose access is juridically assigned.
branch_activations.boundary: The decree relation is attributed and does not make the focus a direct land-allocation statement.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yer ve yere bakan alt bölüm
branch_activations.facet_statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The 5:21 and 5:26 earth occurrences carry the supplied core terrestrial-domain facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sovereignty and interval carriers supply the separate return, and the HFT roles are: The terrestrial domain becomes a specifically assigned space inside God's larger earth; the same lower domain becomes a space of wandering when access to the assigned land is withheld.
branch_activations.activation: The same terrestrial domain is shown first as assigned access and later as the space of wandering after access is withheld, giving the focus earth a jurisdictional trajectory.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Earth remains the ordinary inhabited domain and also becomes the scene where sovereignty assigns, withholds, and conditions access.
branch_activations.boundary: The core earth facet is retained; the access trajectory is exploratory and does not replace the focus's cosmic earth reference.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied 5:23:11 occurrence is the HFT-attributed entrance-threshold carrier; no independent branch gloss is supplied for this context branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sovereignty and interval carriers supply the separate return, and the HFT role is: An entrance supplies the decisive threshold through which promised access must become actual.
branch_activations.activation: The entrance threshold gives the focus's spatial jurisdiction a concrete point at which assigned access becomes actual entry.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The owned domain can be perceived through the threshold that admits movement into it.
branch_activations.boundary: The threshold is a contextual carrier and is not asserted as a lexical meaning of mulk or bayn.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied 5:25:9 occurrence is the HFT-attributed party-distinguishing carrier; no independent branch gloss is supplied for this context branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus interval carrier supplies the separate return, and the HFT role is: Distinguishing and separating parties turns jurisdiction into a request for a controlled boundary.
branch_activations.activation: Separating parties meets the focus interval by making the between-space a controlled boundary between groups.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's interval can carry a jurisdictional boundary between parties as well as a cosmic middle.
branch_activations.boundary: The boundary relation is exploratory and remains tied to the exact 5:25 request.

branch_activations.carrier: The supplied 5:26:3 occurrence is the HFT-attributed prohibition carrier; no independent branch gloss is supplied for this context branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus sovereignty and earth carriers supply the separate return, and the HFT role is: Prohibition reverses assigned access and demonstrates authority over occupancy.
branch_activations.activation: Prohibition meets assigned land as the reverse face of sovereignty: the same authority that permits occupancy can withhold it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus ownership formula can be perceived as including authority over occupancy and exclusion.
branch_activations.boundary: The prohibition relation is an exploratory context extension, not a direct lexical gloss for the focus words.
